svg.title: Forest Service tree oval / BCTS — forest-photo banner
svg.desc: Clean reconstruction using shared native primitives and explicit smooth geometry; no photograph contour tracing. Smooth shared geometry and authentic native charge primitives replace raster contours. Caption wording and arrangement follow this source; substitute outlined caption fonts and source fitting are approximate; clean source-authored tree/wildlife scenes are reused directly. This art-only reconstruction preserves the emblem and white lettering; the photographic forest/truck background is replaced with an authored flat dark green panel so the white vector lettering stays visible.
